axes_source: Read from data/brands/cohere.json: warmth from the hue and chroma of the primary #17171C and the canvas #FFFFFF; contrast from the ink #212121 on that canvas, its depth and the chroma of #17171C; density from its 2px spacing base; geometry from its radii 4, 8, 16, 22, 30px; formality from the chroma of its primary and ink; motion at 0.5 since its motion signature states no duration; type personality at 0.5 since neither face is in the engine's catalog.
